ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) across approximately 92% of the visible surface, with localized high-intensity (white/light grey) regions comprising approximately 8% concentrated primarily at the distal tips and along the trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and basal fluke regions consist of a contiguous low-intensity dark manifold. High-intensity, irregular geometric blobs are localized at the distal tips (notably the right tip) and appear as thin, broken mottling along the trailing edge of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees; significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary. Pixel-amplitude variations range from 5 to 20 pixels, characterized by sharp, irregular peaks and valleys, with higher amplitude serrations on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges of both lobes follow a broad convex trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips, interrupted by high-frequency local serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixels at the left and right distal tips, indicating calcified accretions or barnacle-related scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, nearly parallel vertical high-intensity linear marks located on the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe, approximately 40-70 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring and focal white pigmentation at the fluke tips; visible vertical linear rake marks on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Combination of extreme marginal serration and a focal, dense white mottle at the terminus of the right lobe tip.
